findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sim_classify, sim_get_binding, sim_my_sheets, sim_propose_types, sim_publish_app, sim_receipt · Private data: sim_bind, sim_calibrate, sim_invariants, sim_link, sim_publish_app, sim_reroll · Public sink: sim_calibrate, sim_canonical, sim_prompt, sim_publish, sim_publish_app, sim_publish_compare, sim_receipt, sim_reroll · Destructive: sim_bind, sim_calibrate, sim_compare, sim_create_model, sim_crosscheck, sim_delete_model, sim_diagnose, sim_invariants, sim_param_heatmap, sim_propose_types, sim_publish, sim_publish_app, sim_receipt, sim_reroll, sim_run_pipeline, sim_scenario.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sim_classify, sim_get_binding, sim_my_sheets, sim_propose_types, sim_publish_app, sim_receipt · Private data: sim_bind, sim_calibrate, sim_invariants, sim_link, sim_publish_app, sim_reroll · Public sink: sim_calibrate, sim_canonical, sim_prompt, sim_publish, sim_publish_app, sim_publish_compare, sim_receipt, sim_reroll · Destructive: sim_bind, sim_calibrate, sim_compare, sim_create_model, sim_crosscheck, sim_delete_model, sim_diagnose, sim_invariants, sim_param_heatmap, sim_propose_types, sim_publish, sim_publish_app, sim_receipt, sim_reroll, sim_run_pipeline, sim_scenario

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
